prompt:
Single game hero sprite: a FAITHFUL REDRAW of the attached reference image. Keep EXACTLY the same character, the same costume, the same hammer and the same pose as in the reference; do NOT invent a new design; change only the proportions and the drawing style as written below; remove every watermark, signature and text. The reference is a rough sketch: take ONLY its design from it, never its thin sketchy lines or its muted colours.
CINDER MAUL, male, melee warrior, earth with a fire core, human: a tall powerful armoured warrior about 5 heads tall (a small helmed head, huge broad shoulders and chest, a narrower waist, big gauntlet fists, strong legs), keeping the tall heroic build of the reference. A closed dark steel great helm with a pointed visor and one narrow eye slit glowing bright orange #FF9A2A as one flat shape, no other face visible, and ONE tall swept-back red crest on top drawn as five big smooth clumps with pointed tips. Two huge rounded steel shoulder plates; a BARE ash-grey muscular chest drawn as six big smooth muscle shapes, crossed by ONE dark leather strap with ONE round steel boss on the chest; a pointed steel plate guarding the stomach; big steel gauntlets and forearm guards; steel thigh plates, big round knee plates and heavy steel boots; ONE plain olive-brown cloth panel hanging from the belt in front with a torn hem drawn as four big pointed tatters, and ONE long plain olive-brown cape behind the legs with a torn hem. ONE oversized two-handed stone war hammer about as tall as the whole figure: a long dark steel haft with ring grips and a round butt standing on the ground line, and a huge rectangular head made of three big smooth stone blocks with ONE short steel spike on top and ONE glowing orange diamond gem in the middle of the head. The hammer stands UPRIGHT on the RIGHT side of the image, in front of the body, its butt on the ground beside the front foot, gripped at chest height by the hand on the RIGHT side of the image (the far hand, reaching forward, exactly as in the reference); the hand on the LEFT side of the image (the near hand) is a clenched fist hanging at his side.
SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera: facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the screen, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer so the helm visor and the front of the bare chest are visible, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body. Not a flat profile, not a front view, not a diagonal three-quarter view toward the bottom-right. Visible: the visor pointing to the right, the near shoulder plate in front of the chest, the front of the bare chest, the near arm and leg whole. NOT visible: the back of the helm, the far shoulder plate in full (only its edge shows behind the chest), the far leg in full (partly hidden behind the near leg). Standing UPRIGHT in a calm neutral idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning and not walking diagonally, the feet planted a shoulder-width and a half apart on ONE horizontal ground line, the head tilted about 8 degrees forward. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. Full body from the crest to the boots and the whole hammer visible, centered, the figure filling about 66% of the frame height; the top of the hammer head and the crest at least 12% below the top edge.
COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony, the colours of the reference made brighter, more saturated and cleaner: armour and hammer haft cool steel blue-grey #5C6C80 with deep shadow #2E3848 and light #95A6BA; stone hammer head warm grey #8A8478 with shadow #4E4A44 and light #BDB6A8; bare skin ash grey #B4B0A8 with shadow #7A7670; cloth olive-brown #8E7038 with shadow #4E3C1E; red crest #D63A2C with shadow #7E1C18; glowing orange gem #FF9A2A; cream-white highlight #FFF4DC. Deep shadows tinted toward blue, never pure black; the outline is a thick dark blue-grey.
Everything stays inside the frame with a margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no scenery. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Output: one image, one character only.
Style: bold heroic fantasy game art, NOT a sketch and NOT a realistic painting, designed to read at about 84 pixels tall: very THICK dark outlines of varied weight, thickest around the whole silhouette; FORM-FOLLOWING cel shading in four to five hard-edged tonal steps with light clean shadows tinted toward blue or purple, a bright rim-light shape on the lit edge and cream-white glossy highlight shapes on metal and the gem; big smooth bold shapes, the crest, the cape and the torn hems as big clumps with sharp pointed tips; BRIGHT luminous saturated colours with a warm light side and a cool shadow side, high-key lighting, no muddy brown, no large dark areas, no pastel; no hatching, no scribbles, no fine lines, no skin or fabric texture, no scratches, no soft glow, no blur, no gradients. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
